stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS via College Navigator (fall 2024, Metropolitan Campus only): 5,826 applicants, 91% admitted, 12% of admits enrolled; admit and enrollee counts are not printed, so they are left null. The Common Data Set is published for the whole university (Metropolitan plus Florham: 11,478 applicants, 10,665 admitted) and has no international split, so it is not used for campus figures. Only 4 enrolled first-years (1%) submitted SAT scores, so SAT/ACT percentiles are not reported. Undergraduate enrollment 5,690 is fall 2024. Applicant/admit/enrolled counts replaced with exact IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023) figures, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25 for full-time beginning undergraduates living on campus; tuition includes required fees. Current international estimate is in the cycle file.
